class.name: Vst3Instrument
class.brief_description: A VST3 instrument plugin, played as an audio stream and fed by a [MidiDriver].
class.description: The VST3 twin of [ClapInstrument]: plays a VST3 instrument through any [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D], on any bus, as a [MidiDriver] target. [codeblock] var synth := Vst3Instrument.new() synth.plugin_path = "Surge XT.vst3" $Player.stream = synth $Player.play() midi.set_channel_target(1, synth) [/codeblock] Notes go to the plugin as VST3 note events, on the exact audio sample the driver planned them for. VST3 has no controller events: controllers, pitch bend, channel pressure and program change reach the parameters the plugin assigns to them (its MIDI mapping), and do nothing where it assigns none. The transport reaches the plugin once per audio block, so a loop jump inside a block is heard from the next block on (512 samples at most; [ClapInstrument] gets it on its sample). A plugin with several outputs (its aux output buses) plays each through a stream of its own: see [method get_output] and [method bind_outputs]. Players that play the same instrument all hear its one plugin instance, in step to the sample, as for [ClapInstrument].

method.name: bind_outputs
method.description: Output [code]i[/code] to the [code]i[/code]-th player of [param players] (an [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D] each), and starts each: [code]drums.bind_outputs([$Main, $Kick, $Snare])[/code].

method.name: get_frames_processed
method.description: Frames the plugin has produced so far, over all playbacks.

method.name: get_load_error
method.description: Why the plugin did not load, or an empty string.

method.name: get_output
method.description: Output [param index] as an audio stream, to play in a player of its own, on its own bus: 0 is the main output (this instrument itself), 1 and up the plugin's other outputs. All outputs come from the one plugin instance and the same notes, in step to the sample. [codeblock] $Kick.stream = drums.get_output(1) $Kick.play() [/codeblock]

method.name: get_output_count
method.description: How many audio outputs the plugin has, the main one included (1 for most instruments; a drum machine may have one per drum).

method.name: get_output_names
method.description: The plugin's names for its outputs, the main one first: [code]["Main", "Kick", "Snare"][/code], say.

method.name: get_parameters
method.description: The plugin's parameters: [code]id[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]min[/code], [code]max[/code] and [code]default[/code] for each.

method.name: is_editor_open
method.description: [code]true[/code] while the plugin's window is open.

method.name: midi_event
method.description: A [MidiDriver] target method: the driver calls it with each event (see [MidiDriver] for the arguments).

method.name: midi_stop
method.description: A [MidiDriver] target method: drops what [param source] sent for [param time_us] onwards, and ends its sounding notes there as [param mode] says (see [enum MidiDriver.StopMode]).

method.name: midi_transport
method.description: A [MidiDriver] target method: the driver's transport, which the plugin receives in its process context (tempo, position, loop, playing), once per audio block.

method.name: open_editor
method.description: Opens the plugin's own window, as for [Vst3PluginEffect] (editor only). The inspector's [b]Open Plugin Window[/b] button does the same.

method.name: set_parameter
method.description: Sets parameter [param id] to [param value], in the plugin's own range.

members.member: The parameters set by hand, as [code]{id: value}[/code]. Saved with the scene and applied after [member plugin_state] when it loads, so they win if the two disagree. Parameters not listed keep whatever the plugin holds: its default, or what a loaded state set. Not shown in the inspector, which shows one slider per parameter under [b]Parameters[/b] instead.
Which instrument of a bundle holding several, as 32 hex digits; empty for the first.
The [code].vst3[/code] bundle: relative to a plugin folder, [code]res://[/code] or absolute, as for [Vst3PluginEffect].

The plugin's complete state, as bytes only the same plugin can read: everything it needs to come back exactly as it was, which can be more than its parameters. Saved with the scene. Reading it asks the plugin for its current state. Setting it from a script loads a preset: it replaces every value set by hand so far ([member param_values]).

signal.name: editor_closed
signal.description: Emitted when the plugin's window closes: by the user, by the plugin, or by [method close_editor].

signal.name: parameter_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the plugin changes a parameter itself, for example from its own window. The new value is already stored in [member param_values] and sent to every instance.

signal.name: parameters_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the plugin's parameter list changes while it runs: names, ranges, or which parameters exist. Values for parameters that no longer exist are dropped, and the inspector is rebuilt.
